findings.text: Record mmiowb_state carries two narrow unsigned counters called nesting_count and mmiowb_pending, the first tracking current region depth and the second recording deferred barrier demand for the owning context.

Operations mmiowb_set_pending with mmiowb_spin_lock and mmiowb_spin_unlock form two builds. Enabled build increments depth on entry, copies depth to pending when depth is nonzero, and on exit drains pending through a barrier before decrementing depth. Disabled build makes all three empty with no state change.

The mmiowb spin hooks provide barrier accounting only and do not grant mutual exclusion, ownership, or sleep safety. Correct use keeps nesting_count and mmiowb_pending updates on the same context with exit draining pending at the outermost level.

Generic context interface offers enter_lazy_tlb with destroy_context and deactivate_mm as empty, init_new_context as always successful, and activate_mm as forwarding its two address space arguments plus calling context to the machine switch operation.
Record mod_arch_specific is defined empty, giving ports without architecture module data a complete type with no fields or size guarantees beyond emptiness.

Unsized ELF names Elf_Shdr with program, symbol, dynamic, header, address, relocation forms and type and symbol extractors bind as a group to the wide family in one build and to the narrow family in the other, selecting width by configuration.

Record ms_hyperv_info holds features, priv_high, ext_features, misc_features, hints, nested_features, max_vp_index, max_lp_index, vtl, isolation_config_a with paravisor_present bit, isolation_config_b with cvm_type plus boundary active and boundary bits, shared_gpa_boundary, msi_ext_dest_id and confidential_vmbus_available. Enumeration hv_partition_type holds guest, root and L1VH kinds.
Virtual TPM base named VTPM_BASE_ADDRESS is fixed at hex fed40000. Invalid processor marker named VP_INVAL is the largest 32 bit unsigned value.

Helpers hv_result with hv_result_success and hv_repcomp expose status code extraction, success test and repetition completed extraction from a 64 bit call status. Helper hv_recommend_using_aeoi reports encouragement unless a deprecation hint is present, and helper hv_numa_node_to_pxm_info returns empty for no node and otherwise fills domain with valid and preferred marks.

Repeat helper hv_do_rep_hypercall_ex builds control from code, header size, total count and start position, then loops single calls advancing start by completed amount with periodic liveness touch until total is reached or a failure returns at once. Wrapper hv_do_rep_hypercall begins with start at zero.
Constructor hv_generate_guest_id places Linux vendor identity in the top 16 bits and the supplied kernel version in the middle bits, leaving low bits zero.

Translator hv_cpu_number_to_vp_number is a table lookup from logical CPU to virtual processor. Converter __cpumask_to_vpset with wrappers cpumask_to_vpset and cpumask_to_vpset_skip clears banks through the maximum, optionally skips filtered CPUs, fails when any lookup yields marker VP_INVAL, sets per bank bits for survivors, and publishes a low contiguous valid mask with bank count.

Fallbacks hv_identify_partition_type with hv_is_hyperv_initialized, hv_is_hibernation_supported, hyperv_cleanup, ms_hyperv_late_init, hv_is_isolation_supported and hv_get_isolation_type are inert, reporting false or none and doing no work. Reader get_vtl returns zero. Status formatters hv_status_err and hv_status_debug prefix caller name, decoded code and message.

Predicates hv_root_partition with hv_l1vh_partition and hv_parent_partition compare current type against root and L1VH enumeration values with parent as disjunction when tracking is present, and all three report false when tracking is absent.

Without parent support, hv_result_needs_memory reports false, hv_lp_exists reports false, and hv_call_deposit_pages with hv_call_add_logical_proc, hv_call_notify_all_processors_started and hv_call_create_vp plus hv_deposit_memory_node report operation not supported. Wrapper hv_deposit_memory forwards to the node form with no node.

Record msi_alloc_info named also msi_alloc_info_t bundles descriptor pointer, hardware number, flag word, and two scratch slots each usable as integer or pointer. Depth marker NUM_MSI_ALLOC_SCRATCHPAD_REGS fixes the scratch count.

Depth is two entries. Proxy marker MSI_ALLOC_FLAGS_PROXY_DEVICE uses bit zero and fixed data marker MSI_ALLOC_FLAGS_FIXED_MSG_DATA uses bit one. Marker GENERIC_MSI_DOMAIN_OPS is defined to indicate generic domain operations.
Macro node_distance aliases the underlying distance operation on two node ids. Reader cpumask_of_node returns the global CPU set for no node and the per node stored set otherwise.
Hooks numa_store_cpu_info with numa_add_cpu, numa_remove_cpu, arch_numa_init and early_map_cpu_to_node are empty. Reader early_cpu_to_node always yields zero.
Block budget NR_NODE_MEMBLKS is twice the maximum node count. Tick HZ follows configured kernel rate while USER_HZ and CLOCKS_PER_SEC follow user tick rate.
Minima PCIBIOS_MIN_IO and PCIBIOS_MIN_MEM are both zero. Predicate pcibios_assign_all_busses always affirms, and marker ARCH_GENERIC_PCI_MMAP_RESOURCE is defined.
Reader pci_proc_domain always affirms domain display in process listing for any supplied bus.

Mappers pci_iomap with pci_iomap_wc, pci_iomap_range and pci_iomap_wc_range always report absence, and pci_iounmap is empty. Helper __pci_ioport_map yields absence in one build and forwards to the port mapper in the other.

Offset macro per_cpu_offset indexes a table by CPU, __my_cpu_offset is the raw current offset, my_cpu_offset has preemption aware and raw forms, arch_raw_cpu_ptr shifts a pointer by current offset, PER_CPU_BASE_SECTION is .data..percpu in one build and .data in the other, and PER_CPU_ATTRIBUTES with __percpu_qual are empty.

This CPU generic operations save and restore interrupt state around the raw access, with native width reads using preemption guard and wider reads using interrupt guard, while raw operations perform no guarding and require the caller to prevent migration and interruption.

Generic layer named raw_cpu_generic_read with operator update, add return, exchange, try compare exchange updating expected on mismatch, plain compare exchange, fallback try, and guarded this CPU forms provides the full arithmetic. Sized aliases for widths 1, 2, 4 and 8 covering read, write, add, and, or, add return and exchange all forward to the matching generic form.
Each generic header carries its own include once marker to prevent double inclusion.

Sparse set building fails closed when bank capacity is exceeded or any CPU lookup is invalid, and callers must discard the partially filled set on such errors. Repeat calls must handle early failure and bound total work because progress advances only on success with liveness touches between steps.

Generic PCI mapping always signals absence so callers must test for no mapping before use, and generic Hyper-V fallbacks signal uninitialized and unsupported so callers must not assume host memory, processor, or isolation services exist.
